chapter: Clarifications and portraits: Lester Young, Byas, Blanton, Ben Webster
title: Raymond Scott's CBS band and Charlie Shavers's drinking
summary: With Raymond Scott at CBS, Ben Webster tried to keep up with Shavers's drinking.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: Of course that's the reason he would get -- see we worked together with Raymond Scott, too. Raymond Scott, let's see Charlie Shoverers, Benny Morton, trombone player out of the old Benny-Mo ten Band, and Ben Webster, Specks Powell and myself.

Now when we would have, when we were allowed as much rehearsal time as the show was, right because a half an hour show, we'd have a half an hour rehearsal. And when we'd have a break, Charlie would head straight for the bar, Ben would be right behind him. Charlie would drink, drink, drink and Ben would try to keep up with him. Ben, I mean, he couldn't find his seat. Fall down, knock over the Bandstand, knock over his music stand, his chair. (Laughter). So Raymond Scott called Ben over, he says Ben, he says, don't go out with Charlie, he says, when Charlie plays, his playing is like a graph, it goes up which is unusual because trumpet players tongues get slow when they get
drunk. Charlie says his would get faster. (Laughter). Ben couldn't play a note, his chart would go down. So Ben told say please stop hanging out with Charlie.
CBS in New York. This is the band that Perry Como was the vocalist with and Raymond Scott's present wife.
Yes, well she was adopted. Raymond and his wife adopted her. Then he divorced his wife and married Dorothy. Warlow, Harry Warlow, that was his real name. Mark Warlow's brother.
